model.name: Kandinsky 6 Pro Distilled 30B
model.description: Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro generates 5-second videos with a synchronized soundtrack (speech with lip-sync, music, sound effects) from a text prompt or a start image, distilled for 10 steps.

prompt: A medium shot of a small bakery counter at dawn, wooden shelves of bread behind it. The camera is static. A young baker with curly red hair, a white apron dusted with flour and rolled-up sleeves slides a metal tray of golden croissants onto the counter, wipes her hands on the apron, looks up at the camera and says: <S>Fresh out of the oven!<E> She smiles and steps back as thin steam rises from the pastries toward the window. Warm golden morning light enters from the left, realistic documentary footage with soft shadows. <AUDCAP>Loudly, a cheerful female voice; quietly, a metal tray scraping on wood and the low hum of an oven.<ENDAUDCAP>
